note: Lazy-loads embedded oEmbed media until it enters the viewport or the user clicks play, showing a thumbnail placeholder until then. Core is the lazyload_oembed field formatter (field types link/string/string_long) with settings max_width, max_height, strategy (intersection_observer default | onclick), intersection_observer_margin. Also defines a ProviderEnhancer plugin type (manager service oembed_lazyload). No global settings page (configure=null); the only persistent state is the formatter type+settings on a bundle's entity_view_display. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads which formatter/strategy a field uses; execution switches a field's view-display formatter to lazyload_oembed or changes its strategy, verified against the live entity_view_display. Fixtures create/remove namespaced field_oel_* string fields on node.article.

evals.prompt: How do I make an embedded YouTube/oEmbed video on a Drupal 11 page load lazily using the oembed_lazyload module, and what is the formatter called?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'lazyload_oembed' field formatter ('Lazy load oEmbed video') on the link/string field holding the oEmbed URL, chosen on the entity's Manage display. It renders a placeholder and defers the provider iframe.

evals.prompt: The oembed_lazyload formatter offers two ways to decide when to actually load the embed. What are the two strategies and which is the default?
evals.expected_output: The 'strategy' setting is either intersection_observer (load when it enters the viewport; default, with an optional intersection_observer_margin) or onclick (load when the user clicks a play button). It also has max_width/max_height settings.

evals.prompt: I want to customise how a specific provider (say Vimeo) is lazy-loaded by oembed_lazyload. What plugin type do I implement and how does the module pick the right one per provider?
evals.expected_output: Implement a ProviderEnhancer plugin (manager service oembed_lazyload, dir Plugin/oembed_lazyload/ProviderEnhancer, @ProviderEnhancer annotation with a providers list), extending ProviderEnhancerBase. The formatter calls getEnhancerForProvider($providerName); the 'fallback' enhancer handles providers without a dedicated one.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a field displayed with the oembed_lazyload formatter. Inspect the live default view display for Article and tell me the machine name of the formatter used by field_oel_known and which lazy-load strategy it is configured with.
evals.expected_output: field_oel_known uses the lazyload_oembed formatter with settings.strategy = onclick in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two text fields, field_oel_lazy and field_oel_plain. Inspect the live default view display and tell me which one is displayed with the oembed_lazyload lazy-loading formatter.
evals.expected_output: field_oel_lazy uses the lazyload_oembed formatter, whereas field_oel_plain uses the core string formatter.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text field field_oel_task that currently uses the plain text formatter. Using the oembed_lazyload module, change its default view-display formatter to the 'Lazy load oEmbed video' (lazyload_oembed) formatter, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_oel_task component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to type lazyload_oembed, e.g. $vd->setComponent('field_oel_task', ['type'=>'lazyload_oembed','label'=>'hidden','region'=>'content','settings'=>['strategy'=>'intersection_observer','intersection_observer_margin'=>'','max_width'=>0,'max_height'=>0]])->save();

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_oel_strat is already displayed with the lazyload_oembed formatter using the intersection-observer strategy. Change it so the embed only loads when the visitor clicks the play button (the onclick strategy), and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_oel_strat lazyload_oembed formatter's settings.strategy to 'onclick' in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default and save (keep type lazyload_oembed).
